description: TOP-UP ROW. OSM node 11636679006 transcribes an on-site interpretation board describing this as a Scottish Aviation Twin Pioneer CC Mk 1 named Lang Rajawali and said to be the first aircraft obtained by the newly formed Royal Malayan Air Force in January 1962. Serial deliberately BLANK — the board as transcribed gives none and FM-1001 belongs to a Twin Pioneer on the Kuala Lumpur museum register which may or may not be this airframe. Lang Rajawali is Malay for eagle-hawk and is recorded as the aircraft_name; the phrase "said to be the first aircraft" is the board's own hedge and I have kept it
aliases: Twin Pioneer; Twin Pin; Twin Pioneer CC1; Lang Rajawali
